title: Do these 3 every day this week on the Monday with no room in it
caption: Three exercises to do every day at home: Air Squat for squat, Doorframe Row for pull, Glute Bridge March for hinge. Monday has no room in it and the rest of the week is the same, so the same three run every day and the plan asks you nothing. Save this for the week that has no room.

overlays.text: Do these 3 every day this week. Monday has no room in it.
Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width, sit down between your heels, stand tall.
Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest to your hands.

scenes.footer: Hinge. Done lying on the floor.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge March. 10 reps. Hips up, then lift one knee at a time, hips still.

scenes.footer: A short plan, not a lower standard.

overlays.text: No push and no core this week. Both come back on the first week with room.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete. So is seven.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the three. Seven minutes, and nothing left to decide.

scenes.footer: Save this for the week that has no room.

overlays.text: Which three get you through Monday?
